children: The HR professional takes on a larger leadership role, bringing experience across real estate, packaging and hospitality
ELAN Group has elevated Simran Bhatia to Deputy General Manager – Human Resources, marking her latest progression within the company’s corporate HR function.

Bhatia previously served as Assistant General Manager – HR (Corporate), having earlier held the position of Senior Manager – Human Resources at the real estate group. In her expanded role, she will continue contributing to the organisation’s people management priorities and corporate HR operations.
Before joining ELAN Group, Bhatia worked with UFLEX Group as Manager – HR (Corporate), gaining experience in corporate human resources within the packaging industry.

Earlier in her career, she spent nearly six years with Jaypee Hotels & Resorts, progressing from Assistant Manager – Human Resources to Deputy Manager – Human Resources. She also worked for more than five years with ITC Hotels as Assistant Manager – HR, building a foundation in HR operations and people management in the hospitality sector.

Her professional journey spans corporate HR, employee relations, talent management and HR processes across real estate, packaging and hospitality. The elevation reflects her progression through successive HR leadership roles at ELAN Group as she takes on broader responsibilities supporting the company’s organisational and people priorities.
